standard.summary: 预览采样器的 scheduler 覆盖字段（如 karras/simple 等噪声调度变体）；留空使用采样器默认调度。
standard.effect: 非空时预览/评估采样按该调度器变体组织噪声步；与 sample_sampler（采样算法）是两个正交维度。配置检查器会对不识别的取值给出提示。
standard.whenToUse: 想让预览图的采样调度与你推理端习惯一致（如 dpmpp_2m + karras）时。
standard.avoidWhen: enable_preview 关闭时无效；不确定调度器名称时留空，错误取值不会带来收益。

standard_en.summary: The scheduler override for the preview sampler (karras/simple and other noise-schedule variants); leave it blank to use the sampler's default schedule.
standard_en.effect: When non-empty, preview/evaluation sampling organises the noise steps by that scheduler variant; it is orthogonal to sample_sampler (the sampling algorithm). The configuration checker flags a value it does not recognise.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want the preview images' sampling schedule to match what you use at inference (dpmpp_2m + karras, say).
standard_en.avoidWhen: No effect while enable_preview is off; leave it blank when unsure of the scheduler name, as a wrong value brings no benefit.

advanced.principle: 采样器（算法：euler/dpm++ 等）与调度器（sigma 序列的分布：karras/simple 等）共同决定生成轨迹；分开配置让预览尽量复现用户推理端的组合。
advanced.intervention: 配置定义在 configs_monitoring.py（空 = 默认）；warehouse/training_features/training_config_checks.py 对取值做检查；预览与验证采样链路（router_facade.py 的 preview 键集合、validation_suite）读取传递。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响预览/评估图的观感一致性，不影响训练。
advanced.tradeoffs: 训练器内置采样器对调度器变体的支持面小于专业推理端，不支持的组合会回落默认并提示。
advanced.codePath: configs_monitoring.py:sample_scheduler 定义；training_config_checks.py 取值检查；services/training/router_facade.py 预览键传递

advanced_en.principle: The sampler (algorithm: euler/dpm++ etc.) and the scheduler (distribution of the sigma sequence: karras/simple etc.) together determine the generation trajectory; configuring them separately lets previews reproduce the user's inference-side combination as closely as possible.
advanced_en.intervention: Defined in configs_monitoring.py (empty = default); warehouse/training_features/training_config_checks.py checks the value; the preview and validation sampling chains (router_facade.py's preview key set, validation_suite) read and pass it.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Only affects the visual consistency of preview/evaluation images, not training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The trainer's built-in samplers support fewer scheduler variants than a dedicated inference stack; unsupported combinations fall back to the default with a notice.
advanced_en.codePath: configs_monitoring.py:sample_scheduler definition; training_config_checks.py value check; services/training/router_facade.py preview key passthrough
